covers: Interacting with large language models via API
reading.format: Online learning path with interactive lessons, hands-on exercises, and projects; certificate awarded upon completion.
reading.summary: This path teaches Python programming for generative AI. It starts with Python basics, then covers using large language model APIs, prompt engineering, and building simple automations and applications. Completing it shows ability to develop functional AI-powered applications and earns a certificate.
reading.audience: The page says it is for anyone who wants to integrate AI capabilities into their work, including professionals aiming to add AI to their toolkit. It starts at a basic level, so beginners can follow.
